notice: Delivery Planning contract: who builds, with how many parallel fronts and for when (declare), how long the plan will take and whether it fits (plan), and how the real work compares (measure). Data only. The CLI and the site read the questions through the declared operations (delivery.questions) and never write their own texts. Everything here is computed from files by .gtt/scripts/gtt-delivery.sh: the agent explains and proposes, it never decides.

prompt.en: Who is going to build this?

label.es: Yo, con varios agentes en paralelo
label.en: Me, with several agents in parallel

label.es: Un equipo de personas, cada una con su agente
label.en: A team of people, each with their own agent

prompt.en: How many parallel fronts can you sustain?

note.es: Depende de los límites de uso de tu plan del agente. Si es un equipo, se piden los nombres, que serán los dueños de cada frente.
note.en: It depends on the usage limits of your agent plan. For a team, the names are asked: they own the fronts.

label.es: No sé: GTT propone según el diseño
label.en: I do not know: GTT proposes from the design

prompt.es: ¿Para cuándo necesitas una primera versión usable?
prompt.en: When do you need a first usable version?

label.es: Llegar rápido: recortar y usar servicios existentes
label.en: Arrive fast: cut scope and use existing services

prompt.es: ¿Puedes usar servicios de terceros para lo genérico (login, cobros, correo, archivos)?
prompt.en: Can you use third-party services for the generic parts (login, payments, email, files)?

note.es: Las restricciones también llegan a constraints.md como [PROPUESTA].
note.en: Restrictions also reach constraints.md as a [PROPUESTA].

prompt.es: GTT te avisará cuando un Epic pase de un día completo de agente (8 h). ¿Te sirve ese tope?
prompt.en: GTT will warn you when an Epic goes over one full agent day (8 h). Does that cap work for you?

selection.unanswered: OPEN - nothing is invented; a missing answer is shown as OPEN
selection.state_authority: none - an operating answer, not architecture; it can change at any time (gtt delivery set) because it governs how the work is organised, not what is built

size.notice: GTT measures and reports; the human decides what is too much. The only judgement is against numbers the human declared: scope_cap_h (a target in agent hours) and growth_pct (how much the backlog may grow since the baseline). Neither is a default of GTT's own: scope_cap_h has none, growth_pct is a starting value the human changes with `gtt delivery set --growth-pct`.
size.baseline: taken by `select --apply` when the backlog already holds growth_min_stories open Stories, and again with --rebase; never by an agent
size.unmeasurable: fewer than noplan_min_coverage of the open Stories have a duration: the hours are reported as not measurable, never as 0

label.es: De una pasada: un solo flujo continuo, sin fecha ni cronograma por días
label.en: One pass: a single continuous flow, no date and no day-by-day schedule

choose.es: ¿Qué quieres hacer con el tamaño de este proyecto?
choose.en: What do you want to do with the size of this project?

cap.es: ¿Cuántas horas de agente son demasiado para este proyecto? (un número, o none)
cap.en: How many agent hours is too much for this project? (a number, or none)

pace.es: ¿En qué ritmo hablan los documentos del plan?
pace.en: Which rhythm do the plan documents speak in?

label.es: Mantener como está (el tamaño de hoy pasa a ser la referencia)
label.en: Keep it as it is (today's size becomes the reference)

label.es: Definir cuánto es demasiado (tope en horas de agente)
label.en: Define how much is too much (a cap in agent hours)

label.es: Adelgazar: ver qué se puede recortar, unir o comprar hecho
label.en: Slim down: see what can be cut, merged or bought ready-made

label.es: Cambiar mis respuestas (quién, frentes, fecha, ritmo)
label.en: Change my answers (who, fronts, date, rhythm)

slim_note.es: Recortar o unir Épicas es decisión tuya: pídele a tu agente una propuesta (gtt-propose-change, forma 4). Las historias las reordena el agente sin pedir permiso.
slim_note.en: Cutting or merging Epics is your decision: ask your agent for a proposal (gtt-propose-change, form 4). Stories are reordered by the agent without asking.

values.days: the work is planned in days: the plan, the status and the orders may speak of days
values.flow: continuous flow: Stories are pulled as they free up and the only clock is agent hours; no document speaks of day N, jornadas or a day-by-day schedule

pace.state: pace in .gtt/delivery.json, changed with `gtt delivery set --pace days|flow`; it is an operating answer, never architecture

fields.estimate_format: `<n>h` agent hours, optionally `+ <n> decisions` human decision points; never weeks of a person
fields.budget_values: ok | over - accepted: <reason> - <who> - <YYYY-MM-DD> | over - split | over - cut | over - integrate

signals.DLV-STORY-OVER: a Story In Progress for more than story_over_ratio x its estimate
signals.DLV-EPIC-BUDGET: an Epic over its cap with no decision in Budget
signals.DLV-FORECAST: the forecast finish is after the deadline
signals.DLV-HUMAN-WAIT: a human action (Owner: human) open for more than human_wait_h
signals.DLV-LANE-CROSS: Epics of different fronts declare overlapping Touches
signals.DLV-NO-VALUE: no Epic of Kind slice or skeleton, with a development method declared
signals.DLV-NO-PLAN: noplan_min_stories or more open Stories and fewer than noplan_min_coverage of them with a duration (their own Estimate or their Epic's): nobody can say how long the backlog takes; it fires even when delivery planning was never declared
signals.DLV-STALE-STATUS: a Story that is not Done while a recent commit (last stale_commits_scanned) already closes it by name
signals.DLV-GROWTH: the open Stories (or the estimated hours) grew by growth_pct or more since the baseline taken when the human declared the plan, with at least growth_min_stories more Stories: the project got bigger than declared
signals.DLV-OVER-TARGET: the remaining estimated hours exceed the scope_cap_h the human declared
signals.DLV-PACE-DRIFT: a plan document speaks in the other rhythm than the declared pace (day N, jornada, cronograma under flow)

levels_owned_by: .gtt/contract/profiles.json (profiles.<id>.delivery) - each Autonomy Profile defines what a signal means for it

verification.freeze: gtt-delivery.sh check --pre-freeze: every Planned Epic has an Estimate; an Epic over its cap carries the decision in Budget; with more than one front every Epic has Lane and Touches and no two fronts overlap; every `Build: integrate (ADR-NNN)` names an ADR that exists; every external [FUENTE: ..., consultado AAAA-MM-DD] is younger than source_max_age_days
verification.silent_when: no .gtt/delivery.json and no Epic with a delivery field: a project that never declared delivery planning is never obstructed (the freeze and the check). It is not silent about size: DLV-NO-PLAN, DLV-STALE-STATUS and DLV-PACE-DRIFT are computed anyway and only warn

boundary: GTT plans and watches the fronts. It does not launch, create or orchestrate agents: that belongs to the ADE. `lanes` only prints summaries and the `git worktree add` commands to copy.
